settings.pause_sound_hint: Ambient sound during the breathing pause
settings.notifications_reminders_hint: Streak at risk, return after time away
settings.notifications_footnote: Relock never sends promotional notifications. Once denied in iOS, they can only be restored from system settings.
settings.protection_footnote: Your usage measurements never leave your iPhone: Apple doesn’t hand them to Relock — only an aggregate score is computed on device.
settings.crash_reports_hint: Anonymous error reports, so they get fixed
settings.privacy_footnote: No browsing data, no ad profile, no resale. Crash reports carry neither your email nor your screen content.
settings.share_message: Relock helps me take back control of my screen time. Try it:
settings.logout_body: Your blocks keep protecting this iPhone. Sign back in to find your account again.
settings.delete_body: Your profile, your rules and your whole history will be erased with no way back. Your subscription must be cancelled from your App Store account.
settings.account_footnote: Deleting erases the account and its server-side data. It does not cancel the subscription — that is managed from your App Store account.
settings.sentry_off_body: Nothing is being sent. Check SENTRY_DSN in .env (and SENTRY_ENABLE_IN_DEV=1 for a dev build), then rebuild — react-native-config reads .env AT BUILD TIME.
settings.delete_intro: This erases your Relock account and everything in it, on our servers and on this iPhone.
settings.delete_item_profile: Your profile: name, photo, date of birth
settings.delete_item_rules: Your blocking rules and protected apps
settings.delete_item_history: Your history, your stats and your streak
settings.delete_keep_subscription: Your subscription is NOT cancelled: only Apple can end it, from your App Store account settings. Do that first, or you’ll keep being billed.
settings.delete_error: Deletion failed. Try again, or write to us.
settings.delete_reauth: For your safety, sign in again to delete your account.
settings.emergency_hint: Lifts everything right now — no ritual, no delay
settings.emergency_body: Your {{count}} block(s) will be DELETED and every app becomes available this instant. No breathing, no waiting, no strict mode. You’ll have to build your rules again afterwards.
settings.emergency_partial: Apps unlocked, but {{count}} rule(s) couldn’t be cleared from your account. Try again once online.
settings.emergency_footnote: This escape hatch exists for real emergencies: an interview, a trip, a medical surprise. It deliberately ignores every protection — that’s what guarantees Relock never holds your phone hostage.
settings.uninstall_protection_hint: While a block is active, iOS refuses app deletion
settings.uninstall_explain_body:
While a block is actually protecting you, iOS refuses app deletion. Two things to know:

• The restriction is GLOBAL. Apple offers no way to protect a single app: during a block, no app can be deleted from this iPhone.
• It lifts itself as soon as no block is active — and the emergency unlock, just above, lifts it immediately.
settings.daily_limit_hint: Daily cap on your protected apps
settings.daily_limit_sheet_hint: Past this cap, iOS closes your protected apps until tomorrow.
settings.daily_limit_missing_body: This setting adjusts an existing “daily limit” rule. Create one to choose which apps it caps.
settings.reminder_time_hint: When the evening reminder may arrive
settings.export_hint: Profile, rules and history, as JSON
settings.export_error: Export failed. Try again once online.
settings.feedback_bug_body: Tell us what you were doing and what happened. These technical details help us find the problem:
settings.reset_hint: Start over without losing your account
settings.reset_intro: Your counters go back to zero and your blocks are lifted. Immediate, with no way back.
settings.reset_item_rules: All your blocks and their apps
settings.reset_keeps: What you keep: your account (you stay signed in), your subscription, your language, your theme and your notification preferences.
settings.reset_partial: Blocks lifted, but clearing your account failed. Try again once online.
settings.emergency_quota: You get one emergency unlock per week.
settings.emergency_locked_body: You get one emergency unlock per week. The next one will be available on {{date}}.
